mediaNature: Derivative still frames extracted from fixtures/eval/source.mp4, which is itself generated by Ken Burns zoompan over three still photographs (10s each, 30s total). These are NOT genuine video footage. No temporal tracking signal exists in the apparent motion. The MP4 must never be described as genuine video footage in any manifest or report.

annotationMethod: Annotated by viewing fixtures/eval/frames JPEGs directly in October 2026, before any new model predictions were generated for these cases. All 12 frames re-inspected against the annotations; no corrections required (annotation version gt-v1, corrections list empty). Labels were not derived from GridSight reports or cached predictions. Bounding boxes are annotator visual estimates of prominent foreground assets, adequate for IoU-0.5 demonstration, not survey-grade. Uncertain micro-corrosion on distant steel (R-06) is recorded as uncertain and excluded from detection.
attributionRequired: CC BY-SA 2.0 / CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-SA 4.0: credit the authors above and indicate modifications if republishing frames outside this repository.
shortfalls: No genuine video footage: tracking, temporal frame selection, and note-interval alignment cannot be evaluated here and are reported unavailable.
Single clearly observable defect episode (rust pole); more defect classes and scenes are needed for a production benchmark.
Historical download dates were never recorded; recorded as unknown, never backfilled with the verification date.
No voice notes accompany still frames; voice-note-to-asset matching is unavailable for this dataset.
